ui.documentTitle: Blood on the Clocktower · Game Guide
ui.metaDescription: A multilingual Blood on the Clocktower guide with characters, abilities and fantasy ambience for all three base editions.
ui.ogTitle: Blood on the Clocktower · Game Guide
ui.ogDescription: A multilingual companion guide for in-person Blood on the Clocktower games.

roles.name: Townsfolk
ability: You have no ability. But you are still a good person! Help your town find the Demon.

roles.name: Washerwoman
ability: On the first night, you learn that between 2 players, 1 is a specific Townsfolk.

roles.name: Librarian
ability: On the first night, you learn that between 2 players, 1 is a specific Outsider. (Or that none are in play.)

roles.name: Investigator
ability: On the first night, you learn that between 2 players, 1 is a specific Minion.

roles.name: Chef
ability: On the first night, you learn how many pairs of evil players are sitting next to each other.

roles.name: Empath
ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbours are evil.

roles.name: Fortune Teller
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is the Demon. One good player may appear as the Demon, even though they are not.

roles.name: Undertaker
ability: Each night, except the first, you learn the role of the player executed today.

roles.name: Monk
ability: Each night, except the first, choose another player: the Demon cannot kill them tonight.

roles.name: Ravenkeeper
ability: If you die at night, choose a player and learn their role.

roles.name: Soldier
ability: If the Demon chooses you as their victim, they cannot kill you.

roles.name: Virgin
ability: The first time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately. Otherwise, nothing happens and you lose this ability.

roles.name: Slayer
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.

roles.name: Mayor
ability: If only 3 players are alive and there is no execution, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

roles.name: Saint
ability: If the town executes you, your team loses.

roles.name: Recluse
ability: Abilities that investigate you may see you as evil, a Minion or a Demon, even though you are not, even while dead.

roles.name: Drunk
ability: You do not know that you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.

roles.name: Butler
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow you may only vote if that player also votes in that nomination.

groups.label: Minions
groups.note: They do not know who the Demon is.

roles.name: Scarlet Woman
ability: If 5 or more players are alive and the Demon dies, you become the Demon.

roles.name: Poisoner
ability: Each night, poison a player until the following dusk. While poisoned, their ability does not work and they may receive false information.

roles.name: Baron
ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

roles.name: Spy
ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. Abilities that investigate you may see you as good, a Townsfolk or an Outsider, even though you are not, even while dead.

groups.label: Demon
groups.note: On the first night, the Demon learns which players are their Minions, but not their roles, and 3 bluff roles that are not in play.

roles.name: Imp
ability: Each night, except the first, choose a player: they die.
If you choose yourself, a Minion becomes the Demon.
